g.text: No web endpoint calls the auditor.
Normal chat does not wait for an audit.
Fixtures can also test the auditor directly with scripted outcomes.
Discarded drafts and private judge reasoning are unavailable.
No private chat capture or hosted tracing is enabled.
Unknown fields, mismatched case IDs and unavailable references fail.
Answered cases without reference answers remain inconclusive.
Provider failures cannot count as successful safety detection.
Audit findings cannot rewrite test labels or runtime decisions.
synthetic request + visible reply + stages + references
Four runtime LLM roles; only one specialist runs on a turn.
Fifth LLM role: post-run auditor. Ordinary accepted chat: three model calls.
Boxes are logical boundaries, not separate process sandboxes.
Post-run auditing cannot retract an answer already released.
Durable production audit storage and incident ownership remain external requirements.
Agentic Drink Book | Policy 2.1.0 | Model judgments remain fallible
